title: A dry bucket
summary: If a bucket never tips, the usual lesson cannot reach it.

cards.text:
A lesson that only passes through tips
cannot teach a bucket that never tips.

The dry bucket stays dry.
That is the trap.

question.prompt: A bucket that never tips still gets a normal lesson through its tips.
question.why: There is no tip to carry the lesson.
question.simpler: No tip, no path backward through that bucket.

choices: a dry bucket that cannot learn to tip
a bucket that tips too often
a hole that is too small
question.simpler: The next level is the gentle lie that lets a nearly dry bucket still learn.

recall.question: Can a bucket that never tips learn through its own tips?

deeper.note: Neftci, Mostafa, and Zenke separate this from the other training headaches. Read sections II and III before the fix.

paper.title: Surrogate Gradient Learning in Spiking Neural Networks
paper.section: Sections II and III, the obstacles.

terms.plain: a neuron that never spikes cannot learn
terms.definition: A unit whose true spike derivative is zero, so gradient learning never turns it on.
